verdict.line: You lose if you trade into her Q-W-E combo or stand in the wave once she hits level 6 with R up; you win if you poke with Q and only engage once her E (Valor) charge is spent.

brief.thesis: Riven out-trades you in short exchanges thanks to Broken Wings (Q) mobility and Ki Burst (W) stun, which is why she holds lane and solo-kill advantage and you're sitting at 43% over 107 games. Your only lever is range and attrition: Q (Infected Cleaver) hits at 975 range on a 4s cooldown, which outranges every one of her abilities, so poking rather than closing distance is what actually moves your win rate.

theirWindow.what: Blade of Exile grants bonus AD, extra attack range, and a one-time ranged Wind Slash. Back off the wave rather than soaking minions at partial health.

yourWindow.when: After she dashes in with E spent
yourWindow.what: Her damage-block from Valor is gone, so land Q and toggle W (Burning Agony); she has no escape charge left on Q (Broken Wings) either if she's used all three strikes.

start.why: Highest-performing start here (47.8% over 67 games, 52.8% pick) — the block passive and regen eat into Riven's poke-heavy Q/W trades.

boots.why: Best-performing boots in this matchup (42.1% over 57 games, 50% pick) — cuts the physical damage from her empowered Runic Blade autos.

core.why: Raw HP scales both your Q's max-health damage and your passive/W sustain.
Stacks bonus HP from trading and converts that tankiness into true damage.
Boosts Adrenaline Rush and W's health drain/healing — the top-performing finisher on this path (60% over 10 games).

you are losing early all-ins and need armor plus healing cut sooner

runes.keystoneWhy: Every 4th auto heals you and procs bonus damage, turning your forced short trades (Q is a poke tool, not a stick tool at 975 range) into sustained wins over Riven's shorter-cooldown kit.

summoners.why: Most-played combo here (39.1% pick, 44.2% win rate) — Ghost closes distance once Riven's E (Valor) dash is down, since Mundo has no other gap closer, and Teleport lets you reset off bad all-ins instead of forcing fights you're statistically losing.

playing.title: Poke, don't walk up
playing.detail: Q (Infected Cleaver) hits at 975 range on a 4s cooldown, far outranging her Q/W/E at 275/260/250. Spam it from max range instead of closing distance.

playing.title: Track her E charge
playing.detail: Valor is a 10-6s cooldown dash that blocks incoming damage. If it's down, she can't shrug off your Q procs or disengage from a trade.

playing.title: Play around level 6
playing.detail: Blade of Exile gives bonus AD, extra range, and a one-time ranged Wind Slash. Don't sit in the wave at partial health once she hits it.

playing.title: Toggle W in trades
playing.detail: Burning Agony drains your own health for continual nearby damage and shortens disable duration, so keep it on during any extended exchange, not just all-ins.

playing.title: Pop E before engaging
playing.detail: Masochism grants AD based on missing health, so initiate while already chunked rather than topping off health first.

playing.title: Save R for skirmishes
playing.detail: Sadism's health-for-movespeed/regen trade pays off in drawn-out fights, not her burst window. Don't burn it just to survive one Q-W combo.

playing.title: Respect her solo-kill edge
playing.detail: Solo-kill advantage is hers at 43% head-to-head over 107 games — don't shove freely or facecheck brush alone before level 6.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners, and win rates are pulled from measured Dr. Mundo vs Riven games on the current patch (16.20.1) via OP.GG; the ability readings, trade windows, and power-curve calls are my own tactical judgment.

stats.opponentTip: Force Riven close in with (Q) by managing your distance well! Use [Q] to poke rather than closing in on her first. Be careful of being nuked when she reaches level 6.
